data.title: Macron decries ‘stupid’ comments on France riots
data.description: DOHA - President Emmanuel Macron on Wednesday criticised world leaders for making “stupid” comments about the rioting on the sidelines of protests in France, in an apparent swipe at US President Donald Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

data.title: Celebrity shark steered out of South Korean canal
data.description: SEOUL - A shark that has become a viral sensation in South Korea was coaxed out of a canal in which it was stuck, authorities said on Wednesday, as falling temperatures raised concerns for its survival.

data.title: Authors urge UK to halt ‘draconian’ Palestine Action ban
data.description: LONDON - More than 150 writers and personalities signed an open letter on Wednesday urging the UK government to amend its “draconian” ban on Palestine Action after Irish author Sally Rooney said she was halting book sales in Britain as a result.

data.title: ONE Championship: Chatri floats Nabil vs Carrillo title rematch as featherweight options shift
data.description: Nabil Anane could move up to challenge Nico Carrillo for ONE Championship’s featherweight Muay Thai title, with Chatri Sityodtong floating a rematch as the Scottish champion waits for his next defence.

data.title: HRH Princess Sirivannavari receives Italy’s Knight Grand Cross on October 20
data.description: Italy honours Princess Sirivannavari for promoting Italian art, culture and creativity internationally through fashion, design and craftsmanship.

data.title: President berates countries that ‘insult’ Indonesia over toxic haze
data.description: JAKARTA - Indonesia’s president lashed out on Wednesday against “countries that like to insult” his nation over wildfires that have razed vast areas, spewing toxic haze into neighbouring countries.

data.title: Seized matcha leaves tea lovers hoping for auction
data.description: The seizure of almost 1,000 packs of undeclared matcha green tea powder from Japan, worth more than 500,000 baht, has eager Thai matcha lovers asking whether and when the goods will be put up for auction.

data.title: Pakistani businessman ‘bought Thai ID’ 20 years ago
data.description: A Pakistani fabric store owner in Pattani province has been arrested for allegedly using the identity of a Thai national to obtain a Thai ID card, allowing him to live and run a business in Thailand for nearly 20 years.

data.title: Record-late 30°C heat grips wide swathe of Japan
data.description: KYODO — A wide swath of Japan faced sweltering heat on Wednesday, with temperatures in some regions recording the latest day in the year to top 30 degrees Celsius, prompting many to switch back to summer clothes for the day.

data.title: Nominee hunt targets Chon Buri properties worth B800m
data.description: CHON BURI - Police raided 12 properties worth a combined 800 million baht in Bang Lamung district on Wednesday morning, suspecting them of being illegally owned by foreigners.

data.title: Norwegian fugitive wanted for attempted murder arrested
data.description: SAMUT PRAKAN - Thai authorities are preparing to deport a 19-year-old Norwegian man wanted on attempted murder charges in his home country after arresting him on Wednesday.

data.title: OCEAN LIFE reimagines insurance for the living
data.description: Thailand’s insurance industry has demonstrated resilience amid global uncertainties through the second quarter of 2026, with the t otal life insurance premiums in the first half in 2026 reached THB 341.52 billion, up 4.57% year on year, in which the Thai Life Assurance Association forecasting full-year growth of 2.5–3.5%. Against this challenging backdrop, OCEAN LIFE INSURANCE is seeing a shift in consumer awareness, with life insurance increasingly linked to digitalisation, longer and healthier lives and more sophisticated wealth management.

data.title: North Korea says 'new firepower units' in place after border threat
data.description: SEOUL - North Korea has moved new units into "firing positions", the powerful sister of leader Kim Jong Un said Wednesday, days after Pyongyang warned it was considering deploying additional strike means to its border with South Korea.

data.title: Activist group says grey business crackdown falling short
data.description: A political activist group has urged national police chief Samran Nualma to step up efforts to crack down on grey businesses, scam gangs and online gambling — and on the public officials who turn a blind eye to illegality.

data.title: UK approves new North Sea gas drilling
data.description: LONDON - The UK government said on Wednesday that it had approved plans to begin drilling in a controversial new gas field in the North Sea, ending months of speculation about the future of the site.
